skill_specific_guidance.title: Exploitable Network Systems Analysis
skill_specific_guidance.rule: Assess exploitable exposure from collected network/service evidence only; do not assume exploitability without matching evidence.
For each finding, name the exposed service, protocol/port, affected host/resource, and why the path is reachable.
Separate vulnerability evidence from reachability evidence; both are required for high-confidence exploitable-system findings.
When CVE or external exploit metadata is present, treat it as enrichment and keep the AWS resource evidence as the primary proof.
